description: Render a drawing in any supported format (DXF or PDF) to a PNG you can look at, detected from its bytes rather than its name. Use this when you do not know which format you have. Renders the first page/sheet by default; pass `space` (a name from a describe reply's `spaces`) to render another one.

source.description: An http(s) URL, a local file path, or inline DXF text. A PDF is binary: pass it as a URL or a path, never inline.

space.description: Which space to work on: "Model" (a PDF's page 1, a DXF's model space) or a page/layout name as listed in a describe reply's "spaces". Describe omits it for the whole drawing; render defaults to the first space.

name: render_doc
title: Render a drawing of any supported format
